ops.text: 4.3 Transition Assistance; Return of Data. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) at the Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for a period of up to six (6) months at HDI's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days after such expiration or termination, return to the Company all Content, user information, customer data and other data of the Company in HDI's possession or control in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such Content and data from its systems and certify such deletion to the Company in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no exit mechanics, so on termination our Content and customer data would sit on HDI's systems with no return path. We inserted Section 4.3 giving up to six (6) months of transition assistance at HDI's then-current rates, return of our data in a standard machine-readable format within thirty (30) days after expiration or termination (not on later request), and certified deletion thereafter.
proposal.summary: Insert new Section 4.3 (Transition Assistance; Return of Data) after the Termination Payment provisions, with the 30-day return running from expiration or termination and a standard machine-readable format.
